mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause acute kidney injury; gentamicin is aminoglycoside-induced nephrotoxicity and everolimus requires renal function monitoring as it is renally eliminated and can impair renal perfusion.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) frequently; assess baseline renal function before combination use; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; ensure adequate hydration and avoid concurrent nephrotoxic agents.
